name: 2018 Professional Church Worship Presentation Software-bible Screen
description: Is your Church still using presentation software like MS PowerPoint for their praise and worship services? Or maybe no kind of computer assistance at all? Is it time to "get with the new technology" and incorporate rich multimedia visuals into your praise and worship experience? If so, then this software is for you! Both Windows and Mac versions are provided on this disk. Yes, we all love that office software product made by that corporate giant, Micro soft. Perhaps your church uses Powerpoint in their services. But did you know that company recently moved to a "subscription-based" software platform? If you want to use all of the programs in that Office package, you'll have to cough up money EVERY month FOR THE REST OF YOUR LIFE if you want to keep using it. If you stop paying, none of the files you saved or created can be edited or re-saved until you start paying again! Who has the money for that kind of nonsense? Don't get suckered into turning your software needs into just another expensive, monthly bill
